evaluation: All cases are authored and consumed development. No held-out efficacy or population inference.
input: Authored typed JSON records and supplied typed question; no automatic extraction.
output: Sorted candidate identifiers, declared evidence completeness and selected-record conformance; no approval decision.
primary: Matched candidate-set parity across Python, SQLite and RDFLib under identical explicit semantics.
secondary: Qualified versus deliberately unqualified query diagnostic, Python/SHACL conformance parity, source absence/retrieval omission observational equivalence, conforming false facts.
scope: PENELOPE code-system and inspection-scope matching; Hinge event input/output reachability; BPI item-scoped strictly-earlier receipt lookup. BPI ordering is researcher policy, not company compliance.
unknown: Source absence and retrieval omission expose byte-identical runtime inputs within each family; their causes are scorer metadata only. Supplied completeness flags do not discover hidden omissions.
validation: Required fields, datatype and referential typing only. No external truth, completeness, temporal rule, uniqueness or business-policy certification.
interface_boundary: Hinge reachability includes zero hops if the supplied target itself is Product. Current 144 fixtures start at Material. Candidate queries require Code/Bead/Setting and Item classes as applicable.
